list_projects.title: List Godot projects
list_projects.description: Lists Godot projects in the default project base path and those registered with the project manager

open_godot_project.title: Open Godot project
description: Opens a Godot project in a new Godot editor instance
After calling this tool, all subsequent tools will run in the context of this Godot editor instance. There's no need to use `switch_to_project` afterward.
If the project is already open in a Godot editor, it will switch to it, as if using `switch_to_project`.

list_open_projects.title: List open Godot projects
list_open_projects.description: Lists the projects currently open in each Godot editor instance

switch_to_project.title: Switch to Godot project
description: Switches to using the Godot editor instance which has the given project open.
After calling this tool, all subsequent tools will run in the context of this Godot editor instance.
Can only switch to projects that are currently open: use `list_open_projects` to see which are open, or `open_godot_project` to open a new one.
